content.short: Nansen provides crypto and NFT insights via blockchain analytics tools.
content.description: Since its 2019 launch, Nansen is a blockchain analytics platform that provides tools and dashboards to access data across multiple networks. Users can gain a macro perspective on tokens, search and inspect smart contracts, monitor wallet activity, and explore NFT data for due diligence. The platform also labels and analyzes millions of wallets to add a contextual layer to on-chain data. Nansen asserts that this deeper context helps users make more informed investment decisions.
content.meta: Nansen is a blockchain analytics platform delivering crypto and NFT insights. Discover Nansen and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
